Get Objects from a Collection

Source: R/class_trial_comparison.R
getObjects.Rd

S3 generic for retrieving the objects contained in a collection. The TrialComparison method delegates to $getObjects().

The TrialComparison method returns the list of contained objects.

Usage

getObjects(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'TrialComparison'
getObjects(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object supporting a getObjects() method, such as a TrialComparison.

...

Further arguments. Currently unused for TrialComparison.

Value

For TrialComparison, the list of contained objects in their stored order, retaining supplied names, or an empty list for an empty comparison.

Details

The returned list contains references to the original R6 objects. Changing a contained object affects subsequent comparisons. Replacing or removing entries in the returned list does not change the comparison's membership; use add() and delete() to modify the collection.

See also

getComparison(), fetch.TrialComparison()

Examples

comparison <- getComparison(fixed = getDesignFixed(),
    sequential = getDesignGroupSequential(kMax = 2))
objects <- comparison |> getObjects()
names(objects)
#> [1] "fixed"      "sequential"
identical(objects$fixed, comparison$fixed)
#> [1] TRUE
